This example explicitly selects Spatial token target = 6000 for Shumaila. Original preserves all selected visual latents and uses its calculated token total in Automatic mode.

nodes.title: Add regular references
widgets_values:
One prompt: use @my_character after choosing a package with that alias, or replace it with your selected tag. Use @character: before dialogue.

Optional scene/audio/video nodes are disconnected. Select their files and connect named_reference to the main node to use them. For the scene, mention @room in your prompt. For external voice, associate it with the character and disable Use saved voice.

Inspect Final prompt sent to H3 and Reference and voice assignments. Turbo, SLA and preview remain in the model/sampler chain.

widgets_values_named.text:
Write actions and dialogue in Your complete H3 prompt. Use @shumaila: before each spoken line.

Named nodes declare roles and associations; you do not repeat those declarations in the prompt. Raw image/audio/video sockets remain available and display numeric tags. Raw references are numbered first.

Inspect both diagnostic outputs after running. Changing reference inputs never rewrites your prompt.

widgets_values:
Choose a file in either endpoint node and connect named_reference to the main H3 node. Both endpoints are optional. Use a checkpoint that supports endpoint conditioning; this workflow never switches models automatically.

Keep writing summary and shots in the existing prompt. Endpoints are centre-cropped to the output aspect ratio; the full visual VAE is required. Reference details shows detected mode, frame positions and costs. Ordinary references keep their numbering.

For endpoint-only generation, disconnect the character and other reference nodes. For hybrid generation, keep the references you need. Use separate nodes if the same picture is both an endpoint and a normal reference.
